title: CURIS Summer Internship Program (Computer Science Undergraduate Research Internship)
pay: $8,500 one-time summer stipend; $10,000 for those with financial need

requirements.text: Must be a Stanford undergraduate and maintain undergraduate status through the summer
requirements.source_text: To be eligible for CURIS, a student must maintain undergraduate status through the summer. Students who are not Stanford undergraduates are not eligible for CURIS.

requirements.text: Do research on campus for a full 10 weeks over the summer (40 hours/week)
requirements.source_text: Do research on campus for a full 10 weeks over summer.

requirements.text: Participate in the poster session at the end of the summer
requirements.source_text: Participate in the poster session at the end of the summer.

requirements.text: Fill out a progress report in the middle and at the end of the summer
requirements.source_text: Fill out a progress report in the middle and at the end of the summer.

requirements.source_text: Not engage in another substantial internship, job, or volunteer opportunity (whether funded by Stanford or otherwise) unless all mentors, supervisors, and program coordinators have approved these arrangements. CURIS is a full-time position (40 hours per week in 10 consecutive weeks).

requirements.text: Complete a CURIS profile and rank projects in the matching process
requirements.source_text: The Summer CURIS program uses a formal matching process, where students create a profile and rank the projects they are interested in.

research_topics: Computer science research (all CS department areas)
application_method: Formal matching process on the CURIS website: students create a profile (resume + unofficial transcript), submit a brief project-specific statement of interest per project, and rank projects; faculty rank applicants and CURIS assigns matches using the Gale-Shapley matching algorithm.
eligibility_notes: Stanford undergraduates only; students who are not Stanford undergraduates are not eligible. Students who flip to graduate (co-term) tuition are affected — see CURIS pages for details.
description: The CURIS summer program is for Stanford undergraduates only. Students work with a faculty member in the CS department, joining their group for an entire summer working on a project of mutual interest. Students perform research for 10 weeks (40 hours / week) and present their work at a poster session with other CURIS participants.
